notes.title: "Espionage" Demo Update Now Live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Espionage Demo Update Now Live![/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44846677/e7c1edaf30cfa2430e79cd79b4c3af411a56dff1.png"][/img][/h1][h3]Dear Agents,[/h3][p]We're excited to announce a major update to the [b]free playable demo[/b] of [i]Espionage[/i] on Steam. This update incorporates valuable feedback from our community, delivering significant improvements and expansions to enhance your gameplay experience.[/p][h3][b]Key Updates:[/b][/h3][p][b]Story & Narrative Overhaul:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completely revamped plot progression, character dialogues, and cutscenes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved presentation of key story elements for clearer narrative flow and character motivations[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced environmental storytelling for deeper immersion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay Optimizations & Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Performance Boost:[/b] Improved frame rates and stability[/p][/*][*][p][b]Refined Controls:[/b] Smoother movement, stealth mechanics, and interaction responsiveness[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI/UX Improvements:[/b] More intuitive interface and streamlined interactions[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Addressed multiple issues affecting gameplay[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your Feedback Matters![/b]
Try the updated demo and share your thoughts with us! Your input will help us further polish the game.[/p][p][b]Wishlist Now![/b] If you enjoy the demo, don't forget to add [i]Espionage[/i] to your [b]Steam wishlist[/b]!
[b]Submit Feedback:[/b] Share your suggestions via [b]\[Xiaohongshu][/b] or [b]\[Bilibili][/b] (Search "Espionage").[/p][p]Thank you for supporting [i]Espionage[/i]! Ready to step into the shadows?[/p][p]— The [i]Espionage[/i] Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Beijing Fusion, here we come!
notes.content:
[h2] Hello, everyone! This time we will be attending the 2024 Fusion Games Festival in Beijing this month.
Open the world's first offline trial with a brand new demo!

Beijing Station intelligence sharing
◆ Exhibition time: September 21 - September 22, 2024
◆ Pavilion Address: Beijing Beiren Yichuang International Convention and Exhibition Center

Welcome to D13, try our games, have face-to-face communication, and give us valuable comments ~ ~ [/h2]
